### 2026-11-07: K so I started off by researching and clearly defining what I want my ai to do cuz just ai assistant is incredibly broad and could refer to a wide range of things from a chatbot to Alexa-esque devices

**0.75h**

K so I started off by researching and clearly defining what I want my ai to do cuz just ai assistant is incredibly broad and could refer to a wide range of things from a chatbot to Alexa-esque devices. I did not want either (the latter would too complex :(( ) soooo I settled on my current idea which is a device that can connect to an ai interface and run either  a local model (which is what I will be testing with now) or chat gpt (which I might switch to later due to the limitations of the local model).

 The model would then be able to if necessary access tools (browse,weather, date and time)  and return an output. I also plan to set up study hours and automated-ish text replies if possible because one of the major issues I face while tryna study rn is I KEEP GETTING SIDETRACKED BY TEXTS,I can't help it,lolol, soooo rn I'm considering a system where from for example 4-6 pm it will be study hours and instead of me handling my texts, the deskbot will display the texts on a screen from my notifications  and then I can record an audio response which my interface will decode and then send as a text (I already will have audio to text set up through whisper for this project so I believe that the above feature should not add too much complexity but lets see) or I could have it respond to texts but I'm unsure how that would work, so lets seee.

I decided to use an ESP-32-S3 wifi module as my microprocessor would have to connect to my wifi for this to work. It will also use a display (I haven't looked at which one yet likely the same OLED as my sunbie) a mic module and have a cute 3d printed case >_< (I will see if I can have it display this emoji when inactive or shuffle between random expressions). The next issue was sound, having the output be converted into sound then played through a speaker while possible would add another layer of complexity, which............while doable was not exactly a priority for me (++it would be an ai voice anyw and I'm more of a text typa person), so I decided against going down that route but then I realised that the study hours text feature would work only if I knew when I receive a text (otherwise I'd just keep checking and glancing at the screen to see if I've gotten any texts which would lead me to the same issue I set out tryna solve). I decided to solve this by adding a passive buzzer that beeps whenever I receive anything on my deskbot. I will also have buttons that allow me to interact with it (press to record audio for example).

Anyw tho what I did in this session was mainly look at ideas and prices,lolol , I research by skimming websites and watching some videos and separating features into stuff that I want, stuff that would be nice and stuff that I do not need, allowing me to simplify the project a bit.

### 2026-11-08: Okayy so this journal covers everything I did in the time logged under "hackatime- backend", which if you cannot tell I worked on the backend of the ai using a local model.

**0.02h**

Okayy so this journal covers everything I did in the time logged under "hackatime- backend", which if you cannot tell I worked on the backend of the ai using a local model.
Firstly, I decided to start off by coding any tools that it can use, i.e, browse, search or weather
browse is specifically for when I tell my ai to search for information on a browser (as I did not just wanna give an ai free acess to a browser, it uses playwright) search uses ddgs and only returns the search results without using a browser, the weather tooll first finds coordinates of city then uses it to find the weather of the city, it also defines the possible weather options as a dictionary above (I will be fr I used ai for this, which might be where my 9 mins of ai code on hackatime came from).

### 2026-11-11: Okayyy so this entry is about my firmware

**0.5h**

Okayyy so this entry is about my firmware
I started off by creating a file in Arduino and setting it up as well as ensuring I have the libraries which would be required installed.

![set up Arduino](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/SqenJcVsbXusO3XTlgv7F9V5hj45uC1s/75c1c807d9ebc6d7ea65ca048c64740fd71e86bc5312aad604027c0644a75f20.png)

After that I save the file and open it up in VS Code as hackatime does not work with Arduino. After which I start off my code by including all the necessary libraries.

![I define all libraries](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/SqenJcVsbXusO3XTlgv7F9V5hj45uC1s/b970c86b3307b703cf2431be425faafbeeeab0c91f7258a8d8d6a940b7f1389d.png)

Then I define the GPIO Pin numbers of the components by comparing each net to what it connects to on the ESP on the schematic.

![defined pins](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/SqenJcVsbXusO3XTlgv7F9V5hj45uC1s/476d6e5ceee1fed05fb67110f4892e0cb6de05bec6fb02702e7dfced01306b41.png)
After this I define some basic functions, which are required for my deskbot, likee default settings such as sample rate, single and double press durations and so on. After which I realise that I need WiFi deets so I add that in......then I decide I'm not a fan of the info being in my file sooo I remove them (issue as I later realised is that I just had undefined empty variables now, which I think caused errors)

![funcions](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/SqenJcVsbXusO3XTlgv7F9V5hj45uC1s/23a061843580d9ed87115056fbcfa0dd00a50b9b6c5af7a281cd0db93ef33a01.png)

![privacy but wifif settings](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/SqenJcVsbXusO3XTlgv7F9V5hj45uC1s/9ea94f0ed671c169e2f04012b6de949a8f11621bb76924b55f4592f4e0bac231.png)

After this I created an enumeration of all the states and expressions as it is more convenient and easier to keep track of em that way (I add moreee expressions laster on) and I also define a struct for the buttons, which allows me to create two indiv Buttons A and B.

![button display and mic](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/SqenJcVsbXusO3XTlgv7F9V5hj45uC1s/36f24b8517c43f46ebf0617a68166675e5d9fe457a20fa074c35049bb0bada01.png)
